item.title: v0.5.2
item.description:
What's new

  • Sign in with an API key. Add account offers "Use an API key" beside Google. Make a key on the Control Plane in Users › API keys and paste it. The app sends it once and never keeps it. If that key is revoked or expires, the account goes back to waiting for login.
  • Sign In Again, in place. An account waiting for login has "Sign In Again…" on This Machine and in the account menu, with Google or an API key. The same account comes back: the permissions and MCP servers you gave its bots stay as they are. Log Out would remove them.
  • Type the address you open in your browser. The app finds the Control Plane's API from its web address. An API address still works as before.

Fixed

  • API-key credentials in the usage panel show what was spent today and this month.
  • A login code that runs out is replaced, so a waiting account keeps waiting instead of stopping.
